registerSubtitle: The first user becomes an administrator. Use a strong password (8+ characters, at least three of: upper, lower, digits, symbols).
usernameHint: 2–32 characters: letters, numbers, and underscores (Unicode letters allowed)
usersDescription: Admins can add more users. Each user has their own libraries and books.
deleteUserMessage: User {{name}} will be permanently removed. All of their libraries and books in the app will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
apiUnreachableBody: The app could not load account information. Start the API (for example on the port in DEV_BACKEND_PORT / the Vite proxy target) and try again.
legacyMigratedHint: This install may have created an admin account when moving to per-user libraries. Try username admin and the password from LEGACY_ADMIN_PASSWORD, or the default nookline.
